product_overview: A REST API for a personal blog that supports posts, categories, comments, likes, authentication, and profile updates. The build uses mocked database and auth layers for deterministic behavior in tests and workshop exercises.
core_goals: Provide CRUD workflows for blog posts and categories
Support authentication, current-user lookup, and password reset
Enable social interactions through comments and likes
Allow logged-in users to update their profile and avatar
Enforce validation rules for creating posts and protected admin/user actions

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: Lets users register, log in, fetch their current account, and reset their password using bearer-token authentication.
user_flows: POST /auth/register with valid email, password, username, and name -> Receive 201 with created user payload -> POST /auth/login with the same credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> GET /auth/get-user with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with current user profile
POST /auth/login with an unknown email or wrong password -> Receive 400 with an error message
PUT /auth/reset-password with a valid Bearer token, correct oldPassword, and newPassword -> Receive 200 with success message
GET /auth/get-user without a valid token -> Receive 401 with error message

features.name: Profile API
features.description: Allows an authenticated user to update their name, username, and optional profile picture.
user_flows: PUT /profile with Bearer token and valid name, username, and optional image file -> Receive 200 with updated user object
PUT /profile with missing or invalid profile data -> Receive 500 with error message
PUT /profile without a valid Bearer token -> Receive protected-route error response

features.name: Category Management API
features.description: Provides public category browsing and admin-only category creation, update, and deletion.
user_flows: GET /categories -> Receive 200 with Category[]
GET /categories/{id} for an existing category -> Receive 200 with the category record -> PUT /categories/{id} with Bearer token and updated name -> Receive 200 with updated category
POST /categories with Bearer token and a valid name -> Receive 201 with created Category -> GET /categories/{id} -> Receive 200 with the new category
DELETE /categories/{id} for a missing category -> Receive 404 with message
POST /categories without admin authorization -> Receive protected-route error response

features.name: Post Management API
features.description: Supports viewing published posts, admin post management, and interactions such as comments and likes. Creating posts requires admin access and strict field validation.
user_flows: POST /posts with Bearer token and a valid JSON body containing title, image, category_id, description, content, and status_id -> Receive 201 with creation success message -> GET /posts/{postId} -> Receive 200 with the published post
GET /posts with page, limit, category, and keyword query parameters -> Receive 200 with paginated published posts and totals
GET /posts/admin with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with all posts including drafts -> PUT /posts/{postId} with Bearer token and update fields -> Receive 200 with update success message

POST /posts with a body missing title, with title as whitespace, with category_id as the string "1", with status_id as 99, or with image missing http/https -> Receive 400 with validation message -> No insert is attempted
GET /posts/{postId} for a non-existent post -> Receive 404 with message -> DELETE /posts/{postId} with Bearer token for a non-existent post -> Receive 404 with message
GET /posts/{postId}/comments -> Receive 200 with Comment[] -> POST /posts/{postId}/comments with Bearer token and a non-empty comment up to 500 chars -> Receive 201 with creation success message
POST /posts/{postId}/comments with an empty comment or comment longer than 500 chars -> Receive 400 with message

GET /posts/{postId}/likes -> Receive 200 with like_count -> POST /posts/{postId}/likes with Bearer token -> Receive 201 with like creation message -> DELETE /posts/{postId}/likes with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with like deletion message

tech_stack: PostgreSQL (pg) — mocked in this build via utils/db.mjs MockPool
Supabase JS (@supabase/supabase-js) — mocked in this build via utils/supabase.mjs

body.title: string (required, non-empty after trim, max 200)

Count likes for a post
Like a post (logged-in user)

known_limitations.issue: PUT /posts/{postId} (update post) has no validatePostData middleware
known_limitations.impact: Update accepts invalid / missing fields (bad image URL, wrong types, out-of-range status_id) straight into the UPDATE query

known_limitations.issue: Auth is bypassed whenever NODE_ENV === "test" or no token is supplied
known_limitations.impact: In test mode every request is treated as an admin/user; protected routes cannot be negatively tested for 401/403 without extra setup

known_limitations.issue: Database and Supabase layers are in-memory mocks in this build
known_limitations.impact: Integration tests exercise routing + validation + response contract, not real SQL, constraints, or storage

known_limitations.issue: validatePostData rejects category_id / status_id sent as numeric strings
known_limitations.impact: JSON clients must send real numbers; the multipart branch coerces strings but the JSON branch does not, so behaviour differs by content-type

known_limitations.issue: POST /posts multipart branch builds image URL from Date.now() and never validates an uploaded file's type or size
known_limitations.impact: Any uploaded file is accepted and assigned a fake storage URL
